summary: Implemented and verified a Node-based upstream sync script for the skills registry, paired with a weekly GitHub Actions workflow that opens a PR when snapshots change. Committed those changes, then consolidated the registry repositories by fast-forwarding the managed copies under ~/.gizmo/registries, removing the duplicate project checkouts under ~/projects, repointing installed.json to the managed paths, and updating the skills-registry README. Also cleaned up a stray NUL file left by a shell redirection in gizmo.
decisions: Script lives at scripts/sync-upstreams.mjs and supports --dry-run and --only flags; it validates that snapshots contain SKILL.md files before staging.

Automation workflow lives at .github/workflows/sync-upstreams.yml, runs weekly (cron '17 9 * * 1') and is also workflow_dispatch triggerable; it uses concurrency group 'sync-upstream-skills' with cancel-in-progress: false and force-updates a dedicated automation branch to open or refresh a PR.

Authoritative registry copies are now C:/Users/mchan/.gizmo/registries/gizmo-registry and C:/Users/mchan/.gizmo/registries/gizmo-skills-registry; the ~/projects/* duplicates were removed and the local 'origin' remotes were dropped from the managed clones to avoid circular references.
installed.json was updated to point at the managed registry paths and pin gizmo-skills-registry to commit 1087ff7.
The skills-registry README no longer hardcodes the old C:/Users/mchan/projects path; it instructs users to add the repo via Settings → Extensions.
errors: Initial `node scripts/sync-upstreams.mjs --dry-run` failed with MODULE_NOT_FOUND because the working directory was C:/Users/mchan/projects/gizmo instead of gizmo-skills-registry; reran with an explicit `cd` and the dry run succeeded.
